title: I found an exit in the evil cave
content: I’ve seen discussions here about the cave that you get stuck in if you go in too deep so I think this might be relevant to y’all. I always get stuck in this part that has steep edges and a drop off into really rough waters/rocks. Last night though I was going through it in this place and I was climbing to avoid the water and I reached a rock shelter that had an entrance back to the mall. It was like the rock had broken off to reveal it. This is the first time I ever saw an exit out of there without waking up first so I thought it was pretty cool.
